svg.title: RaCo–ALIKED–LightGlue+ feature matching pipeline
svg.desc: A left-to-right diagram showing an image pair branching into RaCo keypoint detection and ranking and an ALIKED dense descriptor backbone. RaCo locations sample the ALIKED feature field to form 128-dimensional descriptors, which LightGlue+ turns into scored correspondences.
svg.text: RaCo decides where to look. ALIKED describes what is there. LightGlue+ decides what corresponds.
